summary: The pick block function doesn't work with mob spawners
description:
## The Bug:

The pick block function doesn't work with mob spawners.

## Steps to Reproduce:

 - Place down a spawner.

 - 

/setblock ~1 ~ ~ minecraft:spawner

 - Attempt to use the pick block function on it.

 - Take note as to whether or not the pick block function works with mob spawners.

## Observed Behavior:

The pick block function doesn't work with mob spawners.

## Expected Behavior:

The pick block function would work with mob spawners.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a Creative world with default settings.
2. Enter and run `/setblock ~1 ~ ~ minecraft:spawner`.
3. Locate the mob spawner placed by the command.
4. Use the pick block function on the mob spawner.
5. Observe that the pick block function does not work with the mob spawner.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 14w10c, 1.8, 15w49a, 1.8.9, 15w50a, 16w05b, 1.9 Pre-Release 2, 1.9.4, 1.10 Pre-Release 1, 16w42a, 1.15.2, 20w14a, 1.16 Pre-release 6, 1.16 Release Candidate 1, 1.16, 20w27a, 1.16.2 Pre-release 1, 1.16.2 Pre-release 2, 1.16.2, 1.16.3 Release Candidate 1, 1.16.3, 1.16.4 Pre-release 2, 1.16.4, 20w46a, 20w48a, 20w49a, 20w51a, 21w03a, 1.16.5, 21w05a, 21w05b, 21w06a, 21w07a, 21w08b, 21w10a, 21w11a, 21w13a, 21w14a, 21w15a, 21w16a, 21w17a, 21w19a, 21w20a, 1.17 Pre-release 1, 1.17 Pre-release 3, 1.17 Pre-release 4, 1.17 Pre-release 5, 1.17 Release Candidate 1, 1.17 Release Candidate 2, 1.17, 1.17.1 Pre-release 1, 1.17.1 Pre-release 2, 1.17.1 Pre-release 3, 1.17.1 Release Candidate 1, 1.17.1, 21w38a, 21w39a, 21w40a, 21w42a, 21w43a, 1.18 Pre-release 7, 1.18, 1.18.1, 22w03a, 22w05a, 22w06a, 22w07a, 1.18.2 Release Candidate 1, 1.18.2, 22w16b, 22w17a, 1.19, 1.19.1, 1.19.2, 22w43a (includes snapshots)
Observed Behavior: Using the pick block function while targeting a mob spawner does not select the spawner or add a spawner item to the player’s hotbar. The pick block action has no effect on the placed spawner.
Expected Behavior: Using the pick block function on a placed mob spawner should successfully select the mob spawner for the player, just as it does with other blocks. The function should respond consistently when targeting a spawner, allowing the player to obtain or equip the corresponding block without failing to register the interaction.
